checks.exercise: Two-dumbbell floor deadlift; front and side 16 poses and both final 32-frame sheets reviewed.
checks.equipment: Two dumbbells outside the legs, with no barbell or supporting rack.

checks.exercise: High-rack partial deadlift; front and side 16 poses and both final 32-frame sheets reviewed.
checks.equipment: Barbell with two plates and fixed rack safety pins.
checks.setup: Bar begins above knee level on both pins, as explicitly described in the app.
checks.hands: Both hands hold the bar outside the legs throughout the movement.
checks.feet: Both feet stay planted inside the rack; no visible sliding.
checks.movement: Short hip-extension range to standing and controlled return to pins. Sampled bar/body gap remains positive; camera preserves visibility of face and bar.
